title: Come to Heavenly Father’s House
traveler_why: Tonight is a story about being drawn toward a holy place before you have words for why, and Scout the Seeker is the Traveler who presses against the window and gasps at the light.
traveler_about: Scout fits tonight because Scout loves the journey to special places. In Scout’s world today: Scout’s family drove to see the temple, all lit up and beautiful. Scout pressed against the window and gasped, “It’s like a castle of light!” On the peaceful grounds, Scout felt happy and calm and close to Heavenly Father. Just like Isaiah’s message about going up to Heavenly Father’s house, Scout discovered how special it feels to be near His holy home.
